Gold.note: Strong central bank demand and rate cut expectations sustain momentum.

Silver.note: Dual industrial and monetary demand driving outperformance versus gold.

Copper.note: Green energy transition demand offsets softness in Chinese property construction.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and global nuclear renaissance support long-term contract pricing.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on pricing.

Nickel.note: Persistent surplus from Indonesian supply growth caps upside despite EV battery demand.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter curtailments support refined metal prices.

Iron Ore.note: Weak Chinese property sector demand offsets marginal infrastructure stimulus.

Coal.note: Ample global seaborne supply and European demand destruction limit upside.

Rare Earths.note: Weak magnet demand and ample Chinese supply keep prices subdued.

Manganese.note: Soft global steel production margins constrain alloy demand.

PGM.note: Hydrogen economy potential and auto production recovery balance ICE substitution risks.

Potash.note: Steady global agricultural application rates support prices despite adequate inventories.

Aluminum.note: Chinese production capacity caps and green energy demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to precious and base metals provides a solid macro hedge.
